alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark room. Two small block figures with white eyes face each other, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right. The amber one closes its eyes and stretches tall in a yawn. The blue one narrows its eyes and trembles, resisting. It happens again, the blue one resists longer, then gives in and yawns too while the amber one watches smugly. Then the blue one yawns first and the amber one follows. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: yawns are a group project.
